run_video_annotator_task: run the video annotator demo task locally using the inhouse Mephisto operator and config
build_video_annotator_simple: build the video annotator React app with an optional force rebuild and post install script
launch_task_run: launch a Mephisto task run using the provided mephisto configuration from the operator
wait_for_runs_then_shutdown: wait for all task runs to complete then shut down the operator with periodic logging
task_script_decorator: wrap a function as a runnable Mephisto task script with a default config file
